 Suspect killed in Lindstrom officer-involved shooting; 1 other found dead, another injured
 By Kilat Fitzgerald Crime and Public Safety Updated  November 14, 2026 4:35 PM CST Published  November 14, 2026 1:57 PM CST Updated  November 14, 2026 4:35 PM CST ▾ article Authorities process the scene of an active shooter threat in Lindstrom, Minnesota.  (FOX 9) 
 The Brief
 The Chisago County Sheriff's Office said "there is no longer a threat to the public" after law enforcement responded to an active shooter at a home in Lindstrom. 
 Authorities say the suspect was shot and killed by law enforcment.  
 One other person was killed during the incident, and another was injured and taken to the hospital.  
 CHISAGO CITY, Minn. (FOX 9) - The Chisago County Sheriff's Office said a suspect has been shot and killed by law enforcement after responding to an active shooter in Lindstrom Saturday. 
 Officer-involved shooting in Chisago County
 What we know:
 Authorities say the 911 callers reported an active shooter at a home in Lindstrom off of Stacy Trail at about 11 a.m. on Saturday.
 Authorities said later in an update, that the suspect was ultimately shot and killed by law enforcement. One other person was killed, and another was injured and was taken to the hospital. 
 The Chisago County Sheriff's Office said there is no longer a threat to the public. 
 No officers were injured. 
 The Minnesota Bureau of Criminal Apprehension (BCA) will be investigating the incident, authorities said. 
 The public is being asked to stay away from the area as investigators process the scene. 
 What we don't know:
 Authorities did not provide any information on the suspect, the other person that was killed or the person injured. 
 Law enforcement did not say what happened during the incident. 
 The Source: This story uses information shared by the Chisago County Sheriff's Office.
